name: climb-monorepo
description: 4-player real-time vertical climbing mobile game TypeScript monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@climb/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@climb/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@climb/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@climb/shared && npm run test --workspace=@climb/server
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['packages/shared/dist', 'apps/server/dist', 'apps/mobile/.expo'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }))"
